title: United Taiwanese Association at UC San Diego
content_html:
The United Taiwanese Association (UTA) at UC San Diego — known in Chinese as 台灣學友會 — is a registered, non-profit student-run sociocultural organization founded in 1992. It is one of the longer-established Taiwanese student organizations at a UC campus and describes itself as one of the largest Asian-interest student organizations at UCSD, with over 200 members and more than 100 events per year as noted on its official website.

UTA was established to provide a sense of home for overseas Taiwanese students and to serve as a platform for anyone interested in learning about Taiwan. As a sociocultural organization, UTA hosts events throughout the academic year focused on social connection, cultural celebration, and academic encouragement. Its UCSD directory listing states that the organization aims to “strengthen social networks, celebrate Asian culture, and promote academic merit.” Events are open to non-members, though a paid membership provides discounts at partner restaurants and businesses in the San Diego area.

UTA maintains an official website at ucsd-uta.netlify.app, an active Instagram at @ucsduta, and a Facebook group. The organization holds a current 2024–2025 constitution on file with the UCSD Center for Student Involvement.
